    n = len(customers)

        return []

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for x in route:
            s += demands[x]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    # Helper: total cost
    def total_cost(routes):
        s = 0
        for r in routes:
            s += route_cost(r)
        return s

            j = customers[jj]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            savings.append((s, i, j))

    route_loads = [demands[c] for c in customers]
